notes: The wooden town on huge piles (Hobbit x; 'on stilts' is Foster's word, t3). Smaug fell FULL ON THE TOWN — 'Full on the town he fell... The lake roared in' (Hobbit xiv) — not into the lake; the lake came in over the wreck. The year 2941 is App B's; The Hobbit carries no dates.
